title: A Metric Error Left A Plane 55% Short On Fuel
hook: One metric error left a plane 55% short on fuel.
closing: Unit checks feel tedious until one missed conversion puts lives at risk.
question: Should everyone use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% of people live in non-metric countries. A small holdout still creates dangerous conversion points.
A metric mix-up dropped the Mars orbiter to 57 kilometers. The spacecraft flew far below its planned path.
A metric error left the plane 55% short on fuel. It ran dry and had to glide down.
